result.instructions: Tools for StatusPage.me, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which of our status pages has an open incident right now?"; "Post an incident on our API status page saying we are investigating elevated errors."; "Schedule a maintenance window for Saturday 22:00 UTC and notify subscribers.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes StatusPage.me data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run statuspageme_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run statuspageme_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run statuspageme_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. statuspageme_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: statuspageme_list_status_pages
tools.title: List status pages
tools.description: List the status pages in the account, with their names, slugs and settings. Good first call to find a status_page_id. API: GET /user/api/v1/status-pages.

tools.name: statuspageme_get_status_page
tools.title: Get a status page
tools.description: Get one status page by id, with its settings and linked monitors. API: GET /user/api/v1/status-pages/{id}.

tools.name: statuspageme_list_incidents
tools.title: List incidents
tools.description: List incidents, newest first, optionally for one status page or changed after a time. Use it to review recent or ongoing outages. API: GET /user/api/v1/incidents.

status_page_id.description: Only return items for this status page id.

limit.description: Maximum number of incidents to return.

created_after.description: Only incidents created after this RFC 3339 time.

updated_after.description: Only incidents updated after this RFC 3339 time.

tools.name: statuspageme_get_incident
tools.title: Get an incident
tools.description: Get one incident by id, with its status and timeline. API: GET /user/api/v1/incidents/{id}.

tools.name: statuspageme_list_maintenances
tools.title: List maintenance windows
tools.description: List scheduled and past maintenance windows, optionally for one status page or created after a time. API: GET /user/api/v1/maintenances.

status_page_id.description: Only return items for this status page id.

created_after.description: Only maintenance windows created after this RFC 3339 time.

tools.name: statuspageme_get_maintenance
tools.title: Get a maintenance window
tools.description: Get one maintenance window by id. API: GET /user/api/v1/maintenances/{id}.

tools.name: statuspageme_list_monitors
tools.title: List monitors
tools.description: List the uptime monitors in the account (site, API and DNS checks) with their current state. API: GET /user/api/v1/monitors.

tools.name: statuspageme_get_monitor
tools.title: Get a monitor
tools.description: Get one monitor by id, with its check settings and current state. API: GET /user/api/v1/monitors/{id}.

tools.name: statuspageme_get_monitor_availability
tools.title: Get monitor availability
tools.description: Get the availability figures (uptime and related metrics) of one monitor for a period. API: GET /user/api/v1/monitors/{id}/availability.

period.description: Period as the API expects it. The spec does not list the values; omit for the default.

tools.name: statuspageme_list_metrics
tools.title: List status page metrics
tools.description: List the live metrics shown on one status page. API: GET /user/api/v1/metrics?status_page_id=.

tools.name: statuspageme_create_incident
tools.title: Create an incident
tools.description: Create a new incident on a status page. It appears on the public page at once. With notify_subscribers true, subscribers receive a message. API: POST /user/api/v1/incidents.

message.description: First timeline message for the incident.

monitor_id.description: Monitor id linked to the incident, if any.

component_ids.description: Component ids affected by the incident.

notify_subscribers.description: Send a notification to the page subscribers.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key so a retried create does not make a duplicate. Reuse it only with the same body.

tools.name: statuspageme_add_incident_update
tools.title: Add an incident update
tools.description: Add a timeline update to an incident, optionally with a new incident state. It appears on the public page at once. API: POST /user/api/v1/incidents/{id}/updates.

incident_state_id.description: Incident state id as the vendor defines it. The spec does not list the values.

tools.name: statuspageme_create_maintenance
tools.title: Create a maintenance window
tools.description: Schedule a maintenance window on a status page, with start and end times. With notify_subscribers true, subscribers receive a message. API: POST /user/api/v1/maintenances.

affected_monitor_ids.description: Affected monitor ids, as the API expects them (spec type: string).

affected_components.description: Affected components, as the API expects them (spec type: string).

notify_subscribers.description: Send a notification to the page subscribers.

idempotency_key.description: Optional key so a retried create does not make a duplicate. Reuse it only with the same body.

tools.name: statuspageme_update_maintenance
tools.title: Update a maintenance window
tools.description: Change the title, message, times or affected items of a maintenance window. Send only the fields to change. API: PATCH /user/api/v1/maintenances/{id}.

message.description: New description. An empty string clears it.

affected_monitor_ids.description: Affected monitor ids, as the API expects them (spec type: string).

affected_components.description: Affected components, as the API expects them (spec type: string).

notify_subscribers.description: Send a notification to the page subscribers.
